needs_labels.then: Pair a roaming or weak-laning support with a self-sufficient ADC; pair a lane-dependent ADC with a lane-winning support; into dive/engage, pick an anti-dive bot lane
needs_labels.why: A support that can't win lane leaves a lane-dependent ADC with nothing
needs_labels.condition: ((our support has 'Roam / gank' or our support's laning tag is Weak) and our ADC's laning tag is not Strong) or (the enemy team's dive threats (count) is at least 2 and our bot lane's peel (count) is 0)
needs_labels.approximation: Only the two warning cases are checked: a roaming or weak-laning support with an ADC that is not Strong in lane, or 2+ enemy dive threats with no bot-lane peel.

watch_for.when: Enemy jungler is shown on one side (gank, objective, or seen)
watch_for.then: Trade: invade, gank or take an objective on the opposite side; don't run across late
watch_for.why: Cross-map plays carry no counter-gank risk and beat a late counter-gank

watch_for.when: Objective spawning soon
watch_for.then: Keep farming and arrive just in time; don't stand at the pit early
watch_for.why: Waiting wastes tempo the enemy can use elsewhere

watch_for.when: One of our lanes is winning
watch_for.then: Don't gank it; ward its river so it can push freely. Gank lanes where the enemy jungler is confirmed far away
watch_for.why: A winning lane only needs vision; ganks are better spent elsewhere

watch_for.when: Planning a gank or dive
watch_for.then: Hide the intent: don't walk toward the tower or clear wards in view right before committing
watch_for.why: Showing intent gives the enemy jungler time to arrive

watch_for.when: Enemy starts Dragon while we have a Teleport advantage top
watch_for.then: Give the Dragon; dive top or take plates instead
watch_for.why: Trading the objective for a dive and plates can be worth more than contesting

watch_for.when: Lane opponent is missing a key early item (boots) or we hit level 6 first
watch_for.then: Trade hard or threaten the all-in to force them off the wave
watch_for.why: Item and level-6 windows are the cleanest moments to win lane

watch_for.when: We're ahead after the early game
watch_for.then: Protect the lead: don't chase without vision or key summoners; regroup on objectives
watch_for.why: Leads are often thrown in a few bad fights right after laning

watch_for.when: One lane is clearly winning and another can hold on its own
watch_for.then: Play through the winning lane and let the safe lane soak pressure, instead of rescuing it
watch_for.why: Accelerating your carry wins more than evening out a lane that's fine anyway

watch_for.when: A lane is about to reset on a natural timer
watch_for.then: Jungler syncs his base with that lane so they return together
watch_for.why: Synced resets create 2-man pressure; out-of-sync bases waste tempo

watch_for.when: First scuttle / first objective about to be contested
watch_for.then: Arrive with the upgraded Smite and plan camps so it's ready on time
watch_for.why: The smite edge decides early 50/50s

watch_for.when: Mid considering leaving lane to dive bot
watch_for.then: Only go if the dive is near-certain and the enemy mid can't punish the free lane
watch_for.why: A free mid lead can cost more than the bot dive gains

watch_for.when: Trading early drakes for cross-map plays
watch_for.then: Track the enemy's dragon count; stop trading and contest before they reach soul point
watch_for.why: Trading works until the enemy stacks soul and the game flips

scouting.when: The enemy jungler has a predictable start (same first camps, smites a buff at a set time)
scouting.then: Plan a timed invade or buff steal around his habit
Profile each player: gold/XP diff at 15, champion-pool size, win rate on most-played champs, strong-side vs weak-side role. Ban or pressure the predictable or weak-side player

conflicts.note: When R20 applies it replaces R08 on the card; R08 is shown struck through with the reason.
conflicts.text: R20 wins over R08 in this draft.

win_condition.timing_text: No clear game-length preference once early gold is accounted for. Against comps with the same gold at 15, similar comps do -2 pts in games under 27 min and -5 pts in games over 33.
win_condition.objective_text: No objective stands out for this comp type once early gold is accounted for: play the standard path.
win_condition.caveat: Compared with comps that had the same gold at 15, so an early lead alone doesn't explain it. Still an association: objectives taken after 15 are partly a result of how the game is going.
